# apple_beta_recruitment_criterion_options (Data Source)

Lists the device families and OS versions `apple_beta_recruitment_criteria` filters can name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_beta_recruitment_criterion_options" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `options` (Attributes List) Device families and their OS versions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--options))

<a id="nestedatt--options"></a>
### Nested Schema for `options`

Read-Only:

- `device_family` (String) Device family, e.g. `IPHONE`.
- `os_versions` (List of String) OS versions of the family.
